newsitem.title: Singapore: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of PPI.
newsitem.headline: Asian dollar deposits little changed ahead of PPI.

text.p: Asian dollar deposit rates were little changed in featureless trade, dealers said on Wednesday.
They said most traders were sidelined ahead of tonight's release of the U.S. April producer price index (PPI) and March business inventories data.
The producer price index for April, is forecast to be unchanged from the 0.6 percent increase reported in March.
March business inventories are also expected to unchanged from February's 0.3 percent gain.
"The market was quiet and featureless in the morning due mainly to an absence of fresh incentives," a local dealer said.

"Some people are waiting for tonight's release of the producer price index and business inventories figures, for more clues to market direction, but I don't think there will be much impact unless the numbers are way off market expectations," he said.
In day-to-day rates, Wednesday/Thursday and Thursday/Friday were unchanged from Tuesday's common 5-9/16 5-7/16 percent, respectively. Week-fixed was unchanged at 5-5/8 5-1/2 percent.
